_comment: Adds 2026-09-05 — meals typed on Ryan's Timberline list that the catalog lacked, plus kcal citations. Farm to Summit publishes its nutrition panel only as an image, so the maker's spec block as republished verbatim by Garage Grown Gear is cited (Weight … (net); Servings per container; Single serving calories) — the Salomon/runningwarehouse precedent. Good To-Go likewise (Litesmith republishes the maker's spec sheet: Net Weight 3.4 oz (95 g), Total Weight 4.1 oz (116.2 g) — the TOTAL is stored: a food row is what you carry, pouch included, wherever a packaged figure exists). The two Farm to Summit rows carry the maintainer's own scale reading of a whole pouch (measured) because the maker publishes net contents only. Gardetto's from General Mills Foodservice. Per-pouch kcal = servings × single-serving calories.
